يستسهل (form X)
# يَسْتَسْهِلُ (yastashilu) /jas.tas.hi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# يُسْتَسْهَلُ (yustashalu) /jus.tas.ha.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# يَسْتَسْهِلَ (yastashila) /jas.tas.hi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَسْهَل
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
